company.name: Nourish
company.shortDescription: Nourish provides nutrition counseling that is covered by most insurance plans, making it accessible for many individuals.
company.description: Nourish is a healthcare technology company that connects patients with registered dietitians through virtual nutrition counseling services covered by insurance plans. The platform allows users to find dietitians based on their health goals and attend appointments through telehealth, while also offering tools for meal tracking, goal monitoring, and nutrition guidance through its mobile application. Nourish works with registered dietitian nutritionists who provide support for conditions such as diabetes, weight management, cardiovascular health, eating disorders, and pediatric nutrition care. The company states that it partners with major insurance providers to reduce out-of-pocket costs for patients and offers ongoing nutritional care through recurring consultations. In addition to patient services, Nourish publishes educational resources and uses data-driven approaches to support personalized nutrition planning and long-term health management.
